if (!requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("jsonlite is required to emit manuscript calculation values.")
}

if (!exists("values_output_dir", inherits = FALSE)) {
  stop("values_output_dir was not initialised by the point-estimate values chunk.")
}

write_values_entry <- function(file_name, entry) {
  values_output_path <- file.path(values_output_dir, file_name)
  jsonlite::write_json(entry, path = values_output_path, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
  message("Wrote manuscript calculation values: ", values_output_path)
}

sample_total_gross <- sum(sample1$gross)
sample_variance <- var(sample1$gross)
sample_sd <- sd(sample1$gross)
sample_error <- sample_sd / sqrt(n)

t_value_95 <- qt(0.975, df = n - 1)
precision_95 <- t_value_95 * sample_error
lower_95 <- y_bar - precision_95
upper_95 <- y_bar + precision_95
total_lower_95 <- N * lower_95
total_upper_95 <- N * upper_95

t_value_99 <- qt(0.995, df = n - 1)
precision_99 <- t_value_99 * sample_error
lower_99 <- y_bar - precision_99
upper_99 <- y_bar + precision_99
total_lower_99 <- N * lower_99
total_upper_99 <- N * upper_99

t_value_one_sided_95 <- qt(0.95, df = n - 1)
upper_one_sided_95 <- y_bar + t_value_one_sided_95 * sample_error
total_upper_one_sided_95 <- N * upper_one_sided_95

fpc_factor <- sqrt((N - n) / (N - 1))
precision_finite_95 <- precision_95 * fpc_factor

target_precision_600k <- 600000
min_n_infinite <- (N^2 * t_value_95^2 * sample_variance) / (target_precision_600k^2)
min_n_infinite_ceiling <- ceiling(min_n_infinite)
additional_n_required <- min_n_infinite_ceiling - n

n_total <- 131
sample2_mean <- mean(sample2$gross)
stein_total_point <- N * sample2_mean
stein_precision <- N * t_value_95 * sample_sd / sqrt(n_total)

target_precision_300k <- 300000
gamma_finite <- target_precision_300k^2 / (N * t_value_95^2 * sample_variance)
min_n_finite <- N / (1 + gamma_finite)
min_n_infinite_300k <- (N^2 * t_value_95^2 * sample_variance) / (target_precision_300k^2)

k <- 31
n_prop <- 50
f_value_lower <- qf(0.975, df1 = 2 * n_prop - 2 * k + 2, df2 = 2 * k)
p_lower <- k / (k + (n_prop - k + 1) * f_value_lower)
f_value_upper <- qf(0.975, df1 = 2 * k + 2, df2 = 2 * n_prop - 2 * k)
p_upper <- (k + 1) / (k + 1 + (n_prop - k) / f_value_upper)

target_prop_precision <- 0.1
z_value_95 <- qnorm(0.975)
p_hat <- k / n_prop
min_n_prop <- (z_value_95^2 * p_hat * (1 - p_hat)) / target_prop_precision^2
min_n_prop_ceiling <- ceiling(min_n_prop)

k_ext <- 57
n_ext <- min_n_prop_ceiling
f_value_lower_ext <- qf(0.975, df1 = 2 * n_ext - 2 * k_ext + 2, df2 = 2 * k_ext)
p_lower_ext <- k_ext / (k_ext + (n_ext - k_ext + 1) * f_value_lower_ext)
f_value_upper_ext <- qf(0.975, df1 = 2 * k_ext + 2, df2 = 2 * n_ext - 2 * k_ext)
p_upper_ext <- (k_ext + 1) / (k_ext + 1 + (n_ext - k_ext) / f_value_upper_ext)
